result.instructions: Tools for ClinicalTrials.gov, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find recruiting trials for type 2 diabetes in Ohio."; "How many trials are registered for migraine treatment?"; "Show me the full details and eligibility rules for trial NCT04280705.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ClinicalTrials.gov data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run clinicaltrialsgov_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run clinicaltrialsgov_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run clinicaltrialsgov_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. clinicaltrialsgov_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: clinicaltrialsgov_search_studies
tools.title: Search clinical trials (ClinicalTrials.gov)
tools.description: Search the ClinicalTrials.gov v2 study registry. Provide any combination of query terms (condition, intervention, title, location, sponsor, general term) — multiple query.* terms are ANDed together — plus optional filters (status, geo, advanced Essie expression, explicit NCT ids). Returns { totalCount?, studies: [...], nextPageToken? }. Use `fields` to trim the response to specific fields/modules, `sort` to order (e.g. '@relevance', 'LastUpdatePostDate:desc', 'EnrollmentCount:desc'), and pageSize/pageToken to page. GET /studies.

term.description: General full-text 'other terms' query (maps to query.term).

condition.description: Disease / condition to match (maps to query.cond), e.g. 'diabetes'.

intervention.description: Treatment / drug / intervention to match (maps to query.intr).

title.description: Words in the study title (maps to query.titles).

location.description: Study location text, e.g. a city/state/country (maps to query.locn).

ids.description: Restrict to these NCT ids (maps to filter.ids), e.g. ['NCT00841061'].

status.description: Filter by overall recruitment status (maps to filter.overallStatus). One or more of: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, COMPLETED, ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION, NOT_YET_RECRUITING, RECRUITING, SUSPENDED, TERMINATED, WITHDRAWN, AVAILABLE, NO_LONGER_AVAILABLE, TEMPORARILY_NOT_AVAILABLE, APPROVED_FOR_MARKETING, WITHHELD, UNKNOWN.

geoFilter.description: Geo filter as a raw geo-function string (maps to filter.geo), e.g. 'distance(39.0027,-77.1,50mi)'.

advanced.description: Advanced Essie expression applied as an additional filter (maps to filter.advanced).

fields.description: Fields or modules to return, e.g. ['NCTId','BriefTitle','OverallStatus'] or ['protocolSection.identificationModule']. Omit to return full study records.

pageSize.description: Number of studies per page (1–1000; API default 10).

pageToken.description: Opaque token from a previous response's nextPageToken, to fetch the next page.

countTotal.description: Include the total number of matching studies (totalCount) on the first page.

tools.name: clinicaltrialsgov_get_study
tools.title: Get a clinical trial by NCT ID
tools.description: Fetch a single ClinicalTrials.gov study by its NCT id (format NCT######## — the letters 'NCT' followed by digits, e.g. NCT00841061). Returns the full study object { protocolSection, derivedSection?, hasResults? }. Use `fields` to return only specific fields/modules. GET /studies/{nctId}.

nctId.description: The study's NCT id, format NCT######## (e.g. NCT00841061).

fields.description: Fields or modules to return, e.g. ['protocolSection.identificationModule','protocolSection.statusModule']. Omit for the full record.

annotations.title: Get a clinical trial by NCT ID

tools.name: clinicaltrialsgov_count_studies
tools.title: Count matching clinical trials
tools.description: Return only the total NUMBER of studies matching a query, without fetching any records. Accepts the same query terms and filters as clinicaltrialsgov_search_studies (term, condition, intervention, title, location, sponsor, status, geoFilter, advanced). Returns { totalCount }. GET /studies with countTotal=true and pageSize=1.

term.description: General full-text 'other terms' query (maps to query.term).

condition.description: Disease / condition to match (maps to query.cond), e.g. 'diabetes'.

intervention.description: Treatment / drug / intervention to match (maps to query.intr).

title.description: Words in the study title (maps to query.titles).

location.description: Study location text, e.g. a city/state/country (maps to query.locn).

status.description: Filter by overall recruitment status (maps to filter.overallStatus). One or more of: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, COMPLETED, ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION, NOT_YET_RECRUITING, RECRUITING, SUSPENDED, TERMINATED, WITHDRAWN, AVAILABLE, NO_LONGER_AVAILABLE, TEMPORARILY_NOT_AVAILABLE, APPROVED_FOR_MARKETING, WITHHELD, UNKNOWN.

geoFilter.description: Geo filter as a raw geo-function string (maps to filter.geo), e.g. 'distance(39.0027,-77.1,50mi)'.

advanced.description: Advanced Essie expression applied as an additional filter (maps to filter.advanced).

tools.name: clinicaltrialsgov_list_field_values
tools.title: List value statistics for study fields
tools.description: Discover valid values / enums for one or more study fields. Returns per-field value statistics — for each field: its type, unique-value count and topValues [{value, studiesCount}]. Great for finding valid enum values (e.g. OverallStatus, Phase) before building a filter. GET /stats/field/values.

fields.description: Field names to get value statistics for, e.g. ['OverallStatus','Phase'].

types.description: Restrict to fields of these value types (ENUM, STRING, DATE, INTEGER, NUMBER, BOOLEAN).

annotations.title: List value statistics for study fields

tools.name: clinicaltrialsgov_get_study_metadata
tools.title: Get the study data-model (field tree)
tools.description: Return the ClinicalTrials.gov study data model as a tree of module nodes (each with name/title/type/children). Use this to explore what fields/modules exist and their nesting, to build `fields` selections or `sort`/filter expressions. GET /studies/metadata.

includeIndexedOnly.description: Include fields that are indexed-only (searchable but not part of the main data model).

includeHistoricOnly.description: Include fields that exist only in historic study versions.

tools.name: clinicaltrialsgov_get_studies_stats
tools.title: Get study size statistics
tools.description: Return overall study-size statistics across the registry: { totalStudies, averageSizeBytes, percentiles, ranges, largestStudies }. Useful for understanding data volume. GET /stats/size.

tools.name: clinicaltrialsgov_get_api_version
tools.title: Get the ClinicalTrials.gov API version
tools.description: Return the ClinicalTrials.gov API version and the timestamp of the underlying data snapshot: { apiVersion, dataTimestamp }. GET /version.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with ClinicalTrials.gov
prompts.description: What you can do with ClinicalTrials.gov here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_trials_for_a_condition_place_and_status
prompts.title: Find trials for a condition, place and status
prompts.description: The AI searches the registry by condition, intervention, sponsor or location and filters by status or geography. You get a list of matching studies.

prompts.name: read_the_full_record_of_one_trial_by_nct_id
prompts.title: Read the full record of one trial by NCT ID
prompts.description: The AI fetches a study by its NCT id. It can return only chosen fields, so you can read eligibility rules or outcomes of that trial.

prompts.name: count_the_trials_that_match_a_topic
prompts.title: Count the trials that match a topic
prompts.description: The AI returns only the number of studies for a condition, intervention, sponsor, location or status. You see how big a research area is.

prompts.name: sort_trials_by_enrollment_or_latest_update
prompts.title: Sort trials by enrollment or latest update
prompts.description: The AI searches studies and sorts them, for example by enrollment count or last update date. It sums up the largest or most recently updated trials of a sponsor or condition.

prompts.name: look_up_valid_status_and_phase_values_for_a_search
prompts.title: Look up valid status and phase values for a search
prompts.description: The AI lists the values used in fields such as status or phase, and shows the study data model. You can then build a correct filter.
